messages:
taylor: @release-manager heads up: canary build job 7992 failed artifact upload to registry, checksum mismatch on layer 4. deploybot auto-promote paused.

deploybot: auto-promotion blocked by job 'canary-publish'. run: deploy/2026-03-21-79. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/7992 — state: failed (artifact-checksum).

ci-bot: upload output: "PUT /v2/redwood/ingress/blobs/uploads/... 201 Created" then verify: expected sha256:abcd1234 got: abce9999. retry loop attempted 3 times.

priya: that's odd — our artifact pipeline calculates digest from tar stream after gzip; could be transient registry bug or bad upload parallelism. any quick way to verify local build matches registry?

taylor: trying `skopeo inspect` on registry image and comparing digests locally. also reuploading with single-threaded push to avoid multipart race.

ken: if this is a transient registry corruption, i vote pin to last-good and unblock release window. last-good image: prod-2026-03-20-70. We can't risk promo with bad artifacts.

ops-bot: Registry health alert: eu-west-1 object-store reported increased 500s around 15:12 UTC (see https://status.internal/redwood/objstore). Some uploads showed mismatched content-lengths.

priya: ok — options: 1) reupload artifact from CI with single-thread push and re-run canary job (adds ~10m), 2) pin to prod-2026-03-20-70 now and schedule reupload+retry in next change window.

release-manager: Given change window ends in ~20m, prefer pin to minimize customer impact. Do reupload attempt in parallel but don't block the promo. If reupload succeeds before cut we'll consider manual promote off the pin.

taylor: started reupload with single-thread push, monitoring. will post link to new artifact once done.

ci-bot: reupload attempt 1: upload succeeded but digest still mismatched on server side. attempt 2: succeeded and digest matches local sha256: abcd1234. New artifact available: registry.internal/redwood/prod-2026-03-21-7992:canary-temp.

ken: since we already decided to pin, proceeding to pin to prod-2026-03-20-70 and opening follow-up ticket to validate registry durability and add digest-verify step in promotion pipeline.

release-manager: creating pin now. deploybot: run pin command.

deploybot: pin applied: release pinned to prod-2026-03-20-70 for channel canary. Manual promote allowed by release-manager.

priya: filing GH issue #4521: add post-push server-side digest check + fallback single-thread push; also investigate multipart parallelism with our object-store.

ops-bot: scheduled incident review for objstore 2h postmortem.

release-manager: release notes snippet: "Canary promotion paused due to artifact checksum mismatches to registry; pinned to last-good image. Teams reuploaded artifact and follow-up validation scheduled."

ken: TODO: if registry fix lands, we can consider rolling forward the pin tonight after manual validation.

release-manager: thanks all — marking thread closed. will reopen if manual promote happens.
